ALLOW_OAUTH2_FOR_EXTERNAL_USERS.help_text: For security reasons, users from external auth providers (LDAP, SAML, SSO, Radius, and others) are not allowed to create OAuth2 tokens. To change this behavior, enable this setting. Existing tokens will not be deleted when this setting is toggled off.
ALLOW_OAUTH2_FOR_EXTERNAL_USERS.label: Allow external users to create OAuth2 tokens

gateway_access_token_expiration.help_text: How long the access tokens are valid for
gateway_access_token_expiration.label: Gateway access token expiration

CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.help_text: List of CSRF trusted origin URLs. Note, if there are values in Djangos CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGIN, they will always appear in this list.
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.label: Csrf trusted origins

gateway_token_name.help_text: The header name to push from the proxy to the backend service. WARNING: if this is changed, backends must be updated to compensate!
gateway_token_name.label: Gateway token name

jwt_expiration_buffer_in_seconds.help_text: The number of seconds before a JWT token's expiration to revoke it from the cache
jwt_expiration_buffer_in_seconds.label: Jwt expiration buffer in seconds

gateway_basic_auth_enabled.help_text: Enable basic auth to the gateway API
gateway_basic_auth_enabled.label: Gateway basic auth enabled

gateway_proxy_url.help_text: URL to the gateway proxy layer
gateway_proxy_url.label: Gateway proxy url

gateway_proxy_url_ignore_cert.help_text: Ignore certificate to the gateway proxy layer
gateway_proxy_url_ignore_cert.label: Gateway proxy url ignore cert

status_endpoint_backend_timeout_seconds.help_text: Timeout (in seconds) for the status endpoint to wait when trying to connect to a backend.
status_endpoint_backend_timeout_seconds.label: Status endpoint backend timeout seconds

status_endpoint_backend_verify.help_text: Should SSL certificates of the services be verified when calling individual nodes for statuses.
status_endpoint_backend_verify.label: Status endpoint backend verify

resource_client_request_timeout.help_text: Timeout (in seconds) before the resource client will drop requests after forming connections.
resource_client_request_timeout.label: Resource client request timeout

request_timeout.help_text: Timeout (in seconds) before the proxy will report a timeout and generate a 504.
request_timeout.label: Request timeout

password_min_length.help_text: How many numerical characters need to be in a local password
password_min_length.label: Password minimum numerical digits

password_min_digits.help_text: How many numerical characters need to be in a local password
password_min_digits.label: Password minimum numerical digits

password_min_upper.help_text: How many numerical characters need to be in a local password
password_min_upper.label: Password minimum numerical digits

password_min_special.help_text: How many numerical characters need to be in a local password
password_min_special.label: Password minimum numerical digits

allow_admins_to_set_insecure.help_text: Can a superuser account save an insecure password
allow_admins_to_set_insecure.label: Allow system administrators to set insecure user passwords

LOGIN_REDIRECT_OVERRIDE.help_text: URL to which unauthorized users will be redirected to log in. If blank, users will be sent to the login page.
LOGIN_REDIRECT_OVERRIDE.label: Login redirect override

custom_login_info.help_text: Provide a specific information (such as a legal notice or a disclaimer) to a text box in the login modal
custom_login_info.label: Custom login info

custom_logo.help_text: Provide an image file for setting up a custom logo (must be a data URL with a base64-encoded GIF, PNG or JPEG image)
custom_logo.label: Custom logo

SOCIAL_AUTH_USERNAME_IS_FULL_EMAIL.help_text: Enabling this setting will tell social auth to use the full email as username instead of the full name
SOCIAL_AUTH_USERNAME_IS_FULL_EMAIL.label: Social auth username is full email

SESSION_COOKIE_AGE.help_text: Time in seconds before a session expires
SESSION_COOKIE_AGE.label: Session cookie age

DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE.help_text: The default number of items to show on a list page
DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE.label: Default page size

MAX_PAGE_SIZE.help_text: The maximum number of items allowed on a list page
MAX_PAGE_SIZE.label: Max page size

CONTROLLER_SSO_URL.help_text: The URL that is used to kick off authentication for Controller SSO that was configured prior to AAP 2.5.
CONTROLLER_SSO_URL.label: Controller sso url

AUTOMATION_HUB_SSO_URL.help_text: The URL that is used to kick off authentication for Automation Hub SSO that was configured prior to AAP 2.5.
AUTOMATION_HUB_SSO_URL.label: Automation hub sso url
